caption: The drawing depicts a single vase centered within a faintly outlined square on a plain background. The vase itself is predominantly light gray with subtle shading to indicate its curved form and depth. The top rim of the vase is scalloped and edged with a yellowish-gold color. On the front of the vase, there is a painted floral decoration featuring a branch with several leaves and a single flower bud; the leaves are rendered in shades of brown, pink, and light purple, while the flower bud is mainly pink with hints of yellow. There are also touches of yellow on the sides near the top of the vase. The composition is minimal, with the vase occupying most of the central square, and the overall style is soft and delicate, using mostly pastel and muted tones. There is a light handwritten signature or inscription at the bottom right of the central square, reading "S. Sudek."
title: Creamer
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
